name: translation-harness
description: Drive non-interactive coding-agent CLIs as resumable, guardrailed translation workers over a structured corpus, then review what they produced.
author: shbernal

scripts.clean: node --eval "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm test
scripts.lint: biome check src test scripts examples && pnpm run lint:text
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write src test scripts examples
scripts.format: biome format --write src test scripts examples
